parsed.rationale: All 11 members are unnamed extensions (name: "") on `EnvironmentValues` spread across 5 distinct packages — AppServices, Playback, WXUI, Wallpaper, and PlayerHeaderView — each injecting domain-specific keys relevant only to their own package (e.g., PlaylistServiceEnvironment.swift, RadioPlayerControllerEnvironment.swift, AccentColorEnvironment.swift, PlaybackBlendMode.swift). This is the canonical SwiftUI pattern for adding `EnvironmentValues` keys: each feature module extends `EnvironmentValues` locally so that its keys remain encapsulated within the module. Consolidating these extensions would couple unrelated packages together and violate module boundaries. The structural collision is purely coincidental — the extensions share the extended type name but encode entirely unrelated domain concepts.
